narrative.introduction: The Sauce & Condiment Ontology catalogs canonical culinary sauces, condiments, spreads, emulsions, seasoning pastes, and fermented flavor bases used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not recipes, prepared dishes, marinades as recipes, beverage concentrates, or commercial brands.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary sauces and condiments by group — culinary function, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary sauces and condiments across six immutable groups: Mother Sauces, Table Sauces, Condiments, Fermented Sauces & Pastes, Oil-Based Sauces & Dressings, and Savory Spreads & Pastes.
